user.title: My Verisure Authentication
user.description: Enter your My Verisure account credentials to connect to your security system.

phone_selection.title: Select Phone Number
phone_selection.description: Select which phone number should receive the OTP code for two-factor authentication.

otp_verification.title: Enter OTP Code
otp_verification.description: Enter the 6-digit OTP code sent to your selected phone number.

installation.title: Select Installation
installation.description: Select which My Verisure installation you want to add to Home Assistant.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: Your My Verisure credentials have expired. Please re-enter them.

error.cannot_persist: Could not persist the authenticated session
error.cannot_get_installations: Could not get installations from My Verisure
error.installation_not_found: The selected installation is no longer available
error.otp_invalid_phone: The selected phone number is not available for this OTP challenge
error.otp_no_phone_destinations: My Verisure requires OTP verification, but no phone destination is available
error.otp_data_missing: The OTP challenge data is incomplete. Please restart authentication
error.authentication_required: Authentication must be completed before selecting an installation
error.otp_reauth_required: Two-factor authentication required again. Please reconfigure the integration to provide a new OTP code.
error.session_expired: Your session has expired. Please reconfigure the integration to authenticate again.

init.title: My Verisure Options
init.description: Configure additional options for My Verisure integration.

data.auto_arm_perimeter_with_internal: Arm perimeter alarm when any internal alarm is triggered
data.external_photo_updates: Import photos requested outside Home Assistant

data_description.push_enabled: Receives notifications through an independent receiver. Device verification by SMS may be requested again.
data_description.notification_observation: Shows event entities and permits optional event bus publication. Reception and explicitly enabled refreshes continue independently.
data_description.push_state_refresh: Uses a bounded current-state check when Verisure reports an alarm change. Requires notification reception.
data_description.external_photo_updates: Imports existing photos from matching camera notifications, including requests made in the official app. Requires notification reception.
data_description.advanced_event_bus: Mirrors the same safe events on my_verisure_event. Choose one event source per automation. Requires notification observation.

error.invalid_options: Enable notification reception before selecting alarm refresh or external photo updates. Enable notification observation before selecting advanced event bus export.

arm_home.success: Alarm activated successfully in Perimeter mode.

arm_night.success: Alarm activated successfully in Night mode.
arm_night.error: Error activating alarm in Night mode: {message}
arm_night.exception: Error activating alarm in Night mode: {error}

blocked.title: Service temporarily blocked
blocked.message: Too many requests were made, and the service has temporarily blocked further calls. Please wait about 10 minutes before trying again.

camera_refresh_failed.message: Verisure did not confirm a new photo. Wait before retrying. The previous image is retained.

camera_service_blocked.message: Verisure has temporarily blocked requests. Wait about ten minutes before retrying. The previous image is retained.

camera_authentication_required.message: Authenticate with Verisure again before requesting a new photo.
